attack_parameters.description: 2.6.2: The spoofer antenna is on the roof of a vehicle that is stationary for 10 minutes at ~69.212409N,15.858314E, spoofing GPS L1 signals at 10 dBm (true position). Simultaneous jamming of GLONASS G1 at 10 dBm. After 10 minutes, the vehicle physically drives south along Stavedalsveien at 40 km/h, but the spoofed position remains fixed at the initial location. Scenario ends at 11:10 UTC.
